decisions.reason: As a recent software launch with its own page and at least one positive market signal, it is still above a cautious aspiration threshold under high uncertainty, so we would keep it while monitoring adoption.
Its placement on the home page suggests strategic importance and no visible performance shortfall, so boundedly rational management would keep it rather than reallocate resources prematurely.
Although evidence is thinner than for the other launches, its dedicated page and close fit with hosting capabilities support keeping it for another period unless clearer underperformance emerges.
